edges.reason: msg.sender determines allowance spending and transfer authorization in transferFrom.
delegate() authorizes the arbitrary delegatecall solely by comparing msg.sender to owner.
list() authorizes liquidity listing and balance overwrite solely by comparing msg.sender to owner.
block.timestamp is used to build the router deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
The constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, so ownership is derived from the transaction origin.
tx.origin flows directly into the ownership assignment operation.
The constructor grants an infinite allowance to tx.origin on the pair address.
The checkBots modifier performs an external call before transferFrom mutates balances and allowances.
The untrusted botProtection low-level call executes before the guarded transfer state updates, enabling reentrancy.
list() makes an unchecked untrusted external call before writing balances in the loop.
The botProtection state address is the target used by the checkBots modifier.
The low-level call target in checkBots is the botProtection state variable.
The low-level call target in list() is the botProtection state variable.

transferFrom increments balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic that can wrap.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked arithmetic.
